name: fullstack-typescript-app
description: A modern full-stack TypeScript application with Express.js backend and React frontend

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix server" "cd client && pnpm start"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && cd client && pnpm build
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && cd client && pnpm install
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules server/node_modules client/node_modules server/dist client/dist
scripts.type-check: npm run type-check --prefix server && cd client && pnpm lint:ts
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && cd client && pnpm test
scripts.test:watch: concurrently "npm run test:watch --prefix server" "cd client && pnpm test"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix server && cd client && pnpm lint
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix --prefix server && cd client && pnpm lint:fix
scripts.validate: npm run type-check && npm run lint && npm run test
